description: Delete 1 to 20 DNS records of a Cloudflare zone by id (cloudflare_dns_read list shows it) in one batch: all are deleted or none is, and the tool always asks first. add holds up to 20 records created in the same batch, in the form of cloudflare_dns_record_add and checked by its rules; Cloudflare runs the deletes first, so a replacement can take the deleted record's name. A record's type cannot change in place: delete the old record and add the new one with the same name in one call; a swap works the same way. Records managed by another Cloudflare product (a Worker's custom domain, for one) are refused. A deleted record stops answering at once, though resolvers may keep it up to its TTL. The result lists the deleted records as they were, and the records added. If the batch fails without telling whether it was applied, read the records with cloudflare_dns_read before sending it again. Zones are looked up only in the account's own zones.

account.description: The label of the credential pair to use, or "default" for the unlabeled one; left out, the unlabeled pair, else the only label.

add.description: 0 to 20 new records, in the form of cloudflare_dns_record_add: records added in the same batch, replacing the deleted ones: a type change or a swap is one call.

comment.description: A one-line note on the record, up to 500 characters.

content.description: A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS: the value (an IPv4 address, an IPv6 address, a hostname, or the text of a TXT record). Required for these types, not allowed for CAA and SRV.

data.description: CAA (flags, tag, value) and SRV (priority, weight, port, target): the structured value. Required for these types, not allowed for the others.

flags.description: CAA: the flags, 0–255 (0 for most records).

priority.description: SRV: the priority, 0–65535 (lower is tried first).

tag.description: CAA: the property tag, one of issue, issuewild, iodef, issuemail, issuevmc.

target.description: SRV: the host that serves it, or "." when the service is not offered.

value.description: CAA: the property value, such as the CA's domain.

name.description: The record name: relative to the zone ("www", "_dmarc"), "@" for the apex, or full.

priority.description: MX only: the preference, 0–65535 (lower is tried first). Required for MX; SRV takes its priority in `data`.

proxied.description: A, AAAA, CNAME only: send traffic through Cloudflare. Default false; a proxied record's TTL is automatic.

ttl.description: Seconds to live: 1 for automatic, or 60–86400. Default 1.

ids.description: 1 to 20 ids of the records to delete (32 hex digits each; cloudflare_dns_read list shows them); all or none.

items.description: The DNS record id (32 hex digits).

name: cloudflare_dns_record_delete

added.description: The records Cloudflare created, with their ids; empty when `add` was left out.

comment.description: The comment on the record, or null.

content.description: The record content, as Cloudflare shows it.

data.description: The structured fields of types such as CAA, SRV or URI.

modified_on.description: When the record was last modified, or null.

priority.description: The priority of MX, SRV and URI records.

proxiable.description: Whether the record can be proxied.

read_only.description: Whether another Cloudflare product manages the record (a Worker's custom domain, for one): it cannot be changed or deleted here, and the zone file leaves it out.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; 1 means automatic.

type.description: The record type (e.g. A, CNAME, MX, TXT).

deleted.description: The records as they were before the delete, in the order of `ids`; they no longer exist.

comment.description: The comment on the record, or null.

content.description: The record content, as Cloudflare shows it.

data.description: The structured fields of types such as CAA, SRV or URI.

modified_on.description: When the record was last modified, or null.

priority.description: The priority of MX, SRV and URI records.

proxiable.description: Whether the record can be proxied.

read_only.description: Whether another Cloudflare product manages the record (a Worker's custom domain, for one): it cannot be changed or deleted here, and the zone file leaves it out.

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; 1 means automatic.

type.description: The record type (e.g. A, CNAME, MX, TXT).

zone.description: The zone the records belonged to.
